facts.text: Four Bridges earned its name from four historic bridges spanning Willow Creek, each linking a different neighborhood to the town’s heart.
The community sits on Butler County’s eastern border, just north of Mason and south of West Chester Township.
Most homes cluster around two golf courses—Four Bridges Country Club and Green Crest Golf Club—shaping the town’s residential layout.
The local library blends genealogy workshops with coding clubs for kids, reflecting the town’s respect for history and future‑oriented curiosity.
Four Bridges feels like a tight‑knit neighborhood where friendly gardens compete each spring and volunteers rally for the annual clean‑up day.
The town’s spirit is captured in its motto: bridges of steel and concrete, and bridges between generations, traditions, and ideas.
